notes: Adds a retry to production code: a follower SCM rechecks once a second whether it has caught up and can start its datanode server, rescheduling itself from a finally block, with a catch that logs and does not rethrow. Without it a restarted follower on an idle cluster never leaves safe mode. Accepted and flagged with flag/production_retry: a retry added to production code is a self rescheduling call around a catch that does not rethrow, which the checker flags for review and does not reject. The target is the first failing test in Apache JIRA HDDS-16132, which the PR fixes; testFollowerCatchupAfterContainerCreate failed the same way. Kept: every hunk of SCMStateMachine.java; the PR also changes StorageContainerManager.java and two test files, which are dropped. The PR description declares that the change was AI generated ("Generated-by: Codex"); it is used here as a real merged change and recorded as such. Not from IDoFT: neither the PR nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
